name: Leadership Styles
excerpt: Leadership styles in project management include laissez-faire, transactional, servant, transformational, charismatic, and interactional.
notes: Leadership styles in project management include laissez-faire (hands-off), transactional (reward-based), servant (community-focused), transformational (inspirational), charismatic (enthusiasm-driven), and interactional (a combination of transactional, transformational, and charismatic).
context_summary:
- Leadership styles include laissez-faire, transactional, servant, transformational, charismatic, and interactional.
- Laissez-faire is hands-off.
- Transactional is reward-based.
- Servant leadership is community-focused.
- Transformational leadership is inspirational.
- Charismatic leadership is enthusiasm-driven.
- Interactional combines various styles.
